'''Hang Layden''' was an island in the vast [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|Southern Ocean]] of the planet [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]].

==History==
Sometime between [[25,802 BBY]] and [[25,793 BBY]], the island became the subject of a territorial dispute between three landmass developers. Although normally the [[Je'daii]] would have found the case to be too trivial to intervene, the site held suspected archaeological significance in the form of a possible [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] structure a kilometer below ground. The [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] was thus sent to arbitrate between the three parties while covertly ensuring that the ancient site was protected. This she achieved through [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusions|Force illusions]] of rockfalls and ravines blocking the cave network to the ancient ruins, illusions she intended would persist for at least a century. With due success, she successfully helped the three factions negotiate a peaceful division of the island between them.<ref name="Into the Void" />
